title: Returns and restocking policy
content:
Unopened, non-defective stock may be returned within 30 days of delivery for credit, less a 15% restocking fee. Cut-to-length pipe, custom-printed packaging and opened sterile goods cannot be returned. A return needs a return authorisation number from customer service before it is shipped back, and credit is issued once the goods are received and inspected.
This policy does not cover shortages, damage in transit or pricing errors; those are handled as disputes.
